name: Taco Meat
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 pound (about 500 g) ground beef or turkey
1 medium onion, finely chopped (or 1 ½ teaspoons onion powder)
1 medium tomato, chopped (or 1 small can of tomato sauce)
1 teaspoon chili powder (or ⅓ teaspoon each oregano, cumin, garlic powder)

steps: Brown beef and onion together. Drain grease.
Add the rest of the ingredients to the browned meat.
Add more tomato sauce if the mixture is dry.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or less if the mixture begins to dry out.
